skill_name: Describe the advantages of having a well-structured coding process in the software development process.
workflow: The advantages of having a well-structured coding process in the software development process are numerous. A well-structured coding process allows for greater accuracy, since it ensures consistency across the code. It also makes it easier for developers to pick up code from another programmer, as the coding process gives them a clear path to follow.
